metadata.question: Did the surface water extent of Lake Mead decrease between July 6, 2000 and July 3, 2022?

data.raw_code: The question is about surface water extent change in Lake Mead between 2000 and 2022. I need to: 1. Use appropriate water detection data - JRC Global Surface Water would be ideal 2. Define Lake Mead geometry 3. Get water occurrence data for both time periods 4. Compare water extent to determine if it decreased For water detection, the JRC Global Surface Water dataset (occurrence) would be perfect. I'll need to: - Use the JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater collection - Get the occurrence band which shows frequency of water presence - Calculate area of water for both time periods - Compare to see if 2022 < 2000 I'll use a polygon around Lake Mead and calculate water area for both dates. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Lake Mead geometry const lakeMead = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-114.8, 36.1], [-114.7, 36.1], [-114.7, 36.0], [-114.8, 36.0], [-114.8, 36.1] ]); // JRC Global Surface Water dataset const jrc = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater'); // Get water occurrence for both periods const occurrence2000 = jrc.select('occurrence_1'); const occurrence2022 = jrc.select('occurrence_2'); // Threshold for water classification (typically > 80% occurrence) const water2000 = occurrence2000.gt(80); const water2022 = occurrence2022.gt(80); // Calculate water area in square meters const area2000 = water2000.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeMead, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('occurrence_1'); const area2022 = water2022.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeMead, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('occurrence_2'); const [area2000Val, area2022Val] = await Promise.all([ area2000.getInfo(), area2022.getInfo() ]); // Print results console.log(`2000 Water Area: ${(area2000Val / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`2022 Water Area: ${(area2022Val / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Change: ${((area2022Val - area2000Val) / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km²`); // Check for valid data if (area2000Val === null || area2022Val === null || isNaN(area2000Val) || isNaN(area2022Val)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (area2022Val < area2000Val) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
